audio.strategy: Original generated piano-like PCM buffers, synthesized analytically for each note and velocity. Not recordings or Nord samples.

generatedSources.name: Phase 1 analytic struck-string voice
generatedSources.notes: Seven slightly inharmonic sinusoidal partials; 4 ms attack, partial-dependent exponential decay, velocity-dependent harmonic brightness and velocity^1.45 amplitude. Ten-second mono PCM generated at AudioContext sample rate for MIDI notes 28–100. No recorded samples, external assets, or network audio loading.

audio.signalPath: Generated PCM -> per-voice GainNode (220 ms damper release) -> fixed master GainNode at 0.42 -> DynamicsCompressorNode -> destination.
audio.voiceStealing: Releasing first, then oldest sustained/unheld, then oldest held; monotonic voice ID breaks ties. Every stolen source is stopped and disconnected immediately.
audio.status: Idle before first gesture; loading while context resumes; ready only for a running context; error includes the failure and allows retry. Synthesis is the primary source, not a sample fallback. No playable success is claimed when audio initialization fails.
notes: Every panel input, including Master Level, changes only normalized presentation state. It never changes this audio graph.
Sustain is merged across the utility UI, computer Space, and per-port/channel MIDI CC64 owners. Pedal-up releases unheld voices only when the final pedal source is up.
AudioContext creation, backend, MIDI permission request, and browser input target are injectable. Audio-clock release uses source.stop rather than JavaScript timers.

Unit tests evaluate the exact PCM used by the backend and graph ownership. Browser tests additionally render the production audio graph through OfflineAudioContext, requiring no physical output device.
The synthesis approximates a struck-string piano; it does not claim the timbre or samples of a Nord instrument.

surface.geometry: 3.0951 aspect; 54% deck, remaining 46% keybed including bottom rail; six fractions 14/20/8.5/12.5/25/20 per corrected visual spec.
surface.keys: 73, E1–E7; 43 white / 30 black; black height 61% of white key height; hammer-action variant visual representation.
surface.rendering: React DOM and CSS; the reference photo is not used as a rendered background.
surface.presentationState: Flat stable-control-ID -> normalized 0–100 value map, independent from note/audio/MIDI state.
surface.narrowInspection: Fit shows the entire instrument. Inspect scales to 4x inside a horizontally scrollable viewport; Fit restores the overview.

unsupported: All physical panel audio/system features: Master Level, pitch stick, mod wheel, rotary, organ, piano selectors/detail/layers, programs, splits, morphs, scenes, clock, transpose, synth and layer effects. Their visual interaction is implemented; their functional behavior is not.
Recorded piano sample sets and multiple models (Phase 2).
MIDI pitch bend, aftertouch, program changes, pedal noise, half pedal, triple pedal and pedal hardware configuration.
Preset libraries, sample downloads, INFO/size menus and Nord Sound Manager.
declaredGaps: The parent capture harness was not supplied in the isolated workspace. Candidate Playwright captures use the required viewports and filenames, with measurements and browser interaction evidence; these are not claimed as parent-harness captures.
Micro-legends and some secondary controls use compact grouped approximations of the photo; this is a CSS reconstruction, not pixel-identical hardware artwork.
